skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 3 combo strikes to a single target for 40% ATK DMG. If a Critical Strike is triggered, inflicts [Weaken] on the target (ATK decreased by 10% for 1 turn).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 combo strikes to all enemies for 20% ATK DMG, with 60% increased CRIT rate for this attack. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target and those around it for 1 turn (when attacked, adds Injury DMG equal to 20% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 combo strikes to all enemies for 24% ATK DMG, with 75% increased CRIT rate for this attack. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on all targets for 1 turn (when attacked, adds Injury DMG equal to 20% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Every enemy afflicted with [Injured] increases Terrible Tornado's [Crit DMG] by 30%, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
